about_the_game:
STORY

Welcome to Trade Rivals – Goblin Age, a fantasy world full of goblins, elves, and wizards!

The city of Ranorya is a powerful port city, and the merchants guild holds a monthly competition for the city's trade license. Merchants who come to the city from outside to trade try to keep their shops afloat for 1 semester, to become the richest or most respected shop, in order to get an annual license.

Run your own shop, trade goods, and beat other merchants. Use smart strategies to grow your business and become the richest trader. Will you succeed, or will your rivals win?

ABOUT THE GAME

In Trade Rivals – Goblin Age, your goal is to become the top merchant. Buy and sell goods, set prices, and stay ahead of your rivals. But be careful! Your competitors will cheat, use magic, and make secret deals to beat you. You can play Trade Rivals against up to 3 friends! Outsmart them with clever strategies and become the best merchant.

KEY FEATURES

Changing Markets

At the start of each game, you’ll face a unique scenario that changes inflation and the city’s economy. No two games are the same! The market changes with crashes, booms, and inflation.

LUCK Market & Rare Items

Buy rare and powerful items in the luck market. They can bring big profits—or big risks.

Fantasy Customers

Sell to goblins, elves, and wizards. Each one wants different things. Learn what they like to make more money.

Strategy & Tactics

Sabotage your rivals, form alliances, or make secret deals. Every choice changes the game. Will you play fair or get dirty?

short_description: Trade Rivals-Goblin Age is a competitive multiplayer game for up to 4 players where you manage a medieval shop. Outsmart your rivals by setting the best prices, attracting customers, and navigating ever-changing economic scenarios. Will you become the most popular or the last one standing?
